# Parisa M. Hesari, PhD

**Postdoctoral Associate**  
**Epidemiologist | Biostatistician | Causal Inference Researcher**

---

Welcome to my academic website.

I am a Postdoctoral Associate at Western University. My research focuses on causal inference, health equity, mental health, and cancer epidemiology. I develop and apply statistical methods to improve the validity and impact of health research.

## Research Interests

- Causal Inference
- Biostatistics
- Mental Health
- Cancer Epidemiology
- Health Equity
- Survival Analysis
